local.rule: every scenario of the corpus (all four splits, journeys, faulted journeys and risk drafts) at its declared repetitions

ci.rule: the regression split (journeys, faulted journeys and every scenario of a journey intent) at its declared repetitions

sandbox.rule: every scenario of the corpus at its declared repetitions; eligible only with sandbox execution modes and human review

staging.rule: every scenario of the corpus at its declared repetitions; eligible only with sandbox execution modes and human review

production.rule: every scenario of the corpus at its declared repetitions; eligible only with pilot execution modes, human review and the reviewed-risk minimum
